text:
From mocking death so much,

his blood was black.

From mocking the day so much,

his soul was black.

From mocking the people so much,

his life was black.

They simply

killed him.

At the place they found

only a black pit.

There was no one to ask.

translation.title: From Mocking Death So Much...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the repeated blackening and blunt, public erasure of the tyrant figure.
